# RiE dwarf buildings and the Dwarven Expedition

## Generated files

| File | Generator | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `common/buildings/aov_rie_dwarven_buildings.txt`, `common/buildings/aov_rie_mines.txt`, `common/modifiers/aov_rie_ore_modifiers.txt`, `common/scripted_triggers/aov_rie_dwarf_triggers.txt`, `common/scripted_effects/aov_rie_deposit_effects.txt`, `common/script_values/aov_rie_dwarf_values.txt`, `localization/english/aov_rie_dwarves_l_english.yml`, `gfx/interface/icons/building_types/icon_building_*.dds` (the ones the blocks name), `gfx/interface/icons/activities/activity_dwarven_expedition*.dds`, `gfx/interface/icons/activity_{types,phases,option_categories}/aov_expedition_*.dds`, `gfx/interface/illustrations/{activity_backgrounds,activity_header_backgrounds,activity_types,event_scenes}/` (RiE mining and dwarf pictures) | `python -I tools/build_rie_dwarves.py` | RiE's dwarf economy from `tools/data/rie_dwarves.py` and the rewrite rules of `tools/rie_dwarf_rewrite.py` (see Systems, RiE dwarf buildings and the Dwarven Expedition): every block of RiE's `lotr_dwarven_buildings.txt` and the 15 `<ore>_mines_01..10` lines copied under their own keys with `is_dwarf` -> `is_dwarvish_culture`, orc and legacy branches dropped, `dwarven_depths_N` -> `dwarven_hold_N` and the terrain triggers replaced by `aov_rie_hold_province_trigger`, `aov_rie_mountain_terrain_trigger`, `aov_rie_hill_terrain_trigger`, `aov_rie_surface_dwarf_trigger`, `aov_rie_dwarven_holder_trigger`, RiE's goat-innovation holder gate replaced by `scope:holder = { is_dwarvish_culture = yes }` (`BLOCK_REPLACEMENTS`), and the surface-building gates added to `can_construct_potential` (`rie_dwarf_rewrite.gate_surface`, data `SURFACE_*`, lines marked `# Anbennar Overhaul: surface building gate`); the 15 `mining_<ore>_province_modifier` deposits verbatim; the dig prerequisites `aov_hold_dig_requirements_2..10_trigger` (RiE's `dwarven_depths_N` `can_construct` minus the previous-level line); `aov_expedition_roll_deposit_effect` (one `random_list` from `ORE_WEIGHTS`) and `aov_rie_deposit_setup_effect` (`START_DEPOSITS`); loc, and the RiE pictures at RiE's paths (activity art renamed `aov_expedition_*`). The build stops on an identifier (trigger, parameter, innovation, script value, modifier) Anbennar and the game lack, a key collision, a missing icon or a picture whose path another mod already has with other content, and prints every removed item as a note. Never edit the output by hand; rerun after an Anbennar or RiE update. `tools/tests/test_build_rie_dwarves.py` (`FreshnessTests`) fails when the files are stale or orphaned. |

## System

- **RiE dwarf buildings and the Dwarven Expedition:** RiE's dwarf economy for Anbennar's dwarves (spec `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-17-rie-dwarves-design.md`; generator `tools/build_rie_dwarves.py`, data `tools/data/rie_dwarves.py`, rewrite rules `tools/rie_dwarf_rewrite.py`). **Buildings:** every RiE dwarf line under its own unprefixed key (`dwarven_forge_01`, `ruby_mines_01`): underground ones in the 9 holds, surface ones (`aov_rie_mountain_terrain_trigger` / `aov_rie_hill_terrain_trigger`: `mountains`, `desert_mountains`, the four dwarven terrains, plus `hills`) in dwarf-held castles and cities, never in a human-held one (`is_dwarvish_culture` on the holder) and never in a hold. The generator enforces this in `can_construct_potential` (`rie_dwarf_rewrite.gate_surface`, lines marked `# Anbennar Overhaul: surface building gate`): every block whose `is_enabled` or `can_construct*` needs `aov_rie_surface_dwarf_trigger` gets `aov_rie_hold_province_trigger = no` and `scope:holder = { is_dwarvish_culture = yes }` when absent (added today: not-in-holds for `dwarven_tavern`, `goat_pastures`, `dwarven_forestry_03..06`; our castle-level override makes `building_requirement_castle_city_church` true in a hold, so they were offered there and disabled); every block of a `SURFACE_BUILDINGS` line without a terrain gate of its own gets `aov_rie_hill_terrain_trigger = yes` (today `dwarven_outpost`, `dwarven_market`, `dwarven_surface_forge`, `dwarven_surface_workshop`, `dwarven_mustering_grounds`, `dwarven_tavern`; a line also in `HOLD_BUILDINGS` whose block allows holds would get `OR = { hold hill }`, none today: RiE's outposts exclude holds and its terrace farms already have that `OR`). Lines RiE gates by terrain itself keep RiE's gates (`dwarven_forestry` forest, `dwarven_pit_mine` not mountains, `dwarven_surface_farm` level 1 not hills, `dwarven_terrace_farm`, `goat_pastures`): a hill gate would make forestry unbuildable and split the farm line, so the surface farm and pit mine still stand on flat land. Goat Pastures need a dwarven holder (RiE's Iron Hills goat innovation, which Anbennar lacks, is rewritten to `scope:holder = { is_dwarvish_culture = yes }`, `BLOCK_REPLACEMENTS`). Holding lists come from the data into `build_holdings_override.py` (`castle_holding`/`city_holding` get the surface entries, `dwarven_terrace_farm_01`, `dwarven_outpost_01`, `dwarven_mustering_grounds_01` and the 15 mines; the hold holding keeps the castle list plus RiE's `dwarven_holding` list). Hold level stats and dig prerequisites: see Dwarven holds. **Deposits:** RiE's 15 `mining_<ore>_province_modifier` province modifiers, permanent, one per province (`aov_rie_has_deposit_trigger`); one map-wide rarity, `ORE_WEIGHTS` (iron, copper, tin, lead 40 each = 67%; quartz, onyx, peridot, amethyst 12; silver 8; gold 6; sapphire, emerald, ruby 4; diamond 3; mithril 1) generated into one `random_list` in `aov_expedition_roll_deposit_effect`, which also sets activity variable `aov_expedition_ore = flag:<ore>`; `START_DEPOSITS` (`b_hul_az_amekh` ruby, `b_gulandhum` gold, `b_anvilwright` silver) are added by `aov_rie_deposit_setup_effect`, called from the hold game-start on_action (`common/on_action/aov_hold_on_actions.txt`). RiE's mineral regions and legend seeds are not used. **Mines:** `<ore>_mines_01..10`, `can_construct_potential` = the matching deposit, each level needing the holding level of `building_requirement_castle_city_church` (castle, city) or `dwarven_hold_N` (hold); no race requirement. **Activity** `activity_dwarven_expedition` (hand-written: `common/activities/activity_types/aov_dwarven_expedition.txt`, `common/on_action/aov_dwarven_expedition_on_actions.txt`, `common/script_values/aov_expedition_values.txt`, `common/scripted_effects/aov_expedition_effects.txt`, `events/aov_dwarven_expedition_events.txt` (namespace `aov_expedition`), `common/event_backgrounds/aov_dwarven_expedition_backgrounds.txt`, `gui/activity_window_widgets/aov_expedition_success_chance.gui`, `localization/english/aov_dwarven_expedition_l_english.yml`; tests `tools/tests/test_dwarven_expedition.py`): host is a dwarvish ruler above baron tier, location a mountain or dwarven-terrain province of the realm; types Mining (location has no deposit, cost x0.5; the default while a realm mountain province has no deposit, and counted in the planner's predicted cost) and Archaeology (the unconditional fallback default; dwarven terrain only; a placeholder: prestige and a log entry through `aov_expedition_archaeology_outcome_effect`, the hook to fill later); crew option (local miners / skilled delvers / master delvers, +0/+10/+20); 8-month phase, pulse events (`aov_expedition.101..106`) for player attendees at months 2, 4, 6, outcome at month 7; success chance `aov_expedition_success_chance` = 30 + stewardship/4 (max 10) + crew + 10 in a hold, max 90, moved by 3/5/10 per pulse; Mining success (`.900`) rolls a deposit and names it, failure (`.901`) refunds half the base cost, Archaeology is `.902`; 4-year cooldown. RiE pictures (activity icon and header, type icons, `lotr_cave_interior`, `lotr_halls`, `lotr_dwarven_gate`) are copied at RiE's paths or renamed `aov_expedition_*`. **To confirm in game:** (1) holds are much stronger with every RiE line (fort level 20, up to 9 extra slots); tune in data. (2) RiE blocks leaning on men-at-arms or modifiers not caught by name (the build's unknown-identifier stop and tiger are the guards). (3) The planner needs every option and phase art and loc key or shows blanks. (4) Holds lose the three removed buildings in old saves. (5) The expedition shows in the planner for a dwarf ruler and not for a human; a Mining expedition can end with a deposit and the mine can be built in a castle, city and hold; Delve Deeper shows the greyed level-N requirements; the three backgrounds and icons load; Goat Pastures and the Tavern are absent from the build list of a human-held hill castle and of a dwarven hold, and present in a dwarf-held hill castle. (6) `save_temporary_scope_as = digger` inside the `show_as_unavailable` blocks of the Delve Deeper picker (`aov_hold_delve.1`) may not be valid there. (7) The outcome roll `random = { chance = scope:activity.var:aov_expedition_success_chance ... }` takes a variable as its chance; check it rolls the variable's current value. (8) The ore name in the success event (`triggered_desc` per ore on `scope:activity.var:aov_expedition_ore ?= flag:<ore>`) shows the right ore, and the known-deposit fallback when the roll did nothing. (9) Guests pay their own gold for pulse options that move the host's chance. (10) Four RiE pictures are plain git blobs, ~2.3 MB in all, kept plain on purpose: `.gitattributes` has no LFS rule for their folders: `activity_backgrounds/lotr_cave_interior.dds` (~900 KB), `activity_header_backgrounds/activity_dwarven_expedition.dds` (~724 KB) and `activity_types/aov_expedition_mining.dds` and `aov_expedition_archaeology.dds` (~339 KB each), all under `gfx/interface/illustrations/`.
